purpose: All-green healer clothing, tidied sprout hair, clearer project three-quarter left faces and direct gem-icon repaint.

records.label: A 青叶药匣
records.prompt:
Repaint ONE healer design into the project's GREEN PALETTE, ACTUAL GEM-ICON RENDERING and consistent THREE-QUARTER LEFT FACE DIRECTION.
IMAGE1 is the specific healer costume/prop design to retain. IMAGE2 is the primary painting authority, the project's approved healing gem: bold dark contour, saturated green body masses, a few broad matte lit/side planes, limited broad brushwork. IMAGE3 is ONLY the project's facial/head viewing direction and grounded standing reference, NOT adult anatomy, face identity, red outfit, sword or hairstyle to copy.

Keep the same youthful wholesome green-haired sprout healer identity and the variant's clothing cut and dominant medicinal prop. ALL CLOTHING colors now belong to leaf-green / sage / ivory / deep forest-green-charcoal with tiny dull-gold fastenings. Remove rose/pink/plum and red clothing accents; use olive/deep-green ties instead. Natural wooden/bamboo/gourd props may stay warm brown for material contrast, not painted all green.
TOP SPROUT SIGNATURE remains TWO large leaf-shaped forms, one upward and one outward, integrated naturally into the crown. Refine the haircut to suit the project: fewer broader bob locks, clean directional fringe, slightly shorter side leaf locks and smaller quieter white pom-pom ties if present. Avoid a huge round front-facing hair helmet; clear face silhouette and neck. No entirely new hairstyle or loss of sprout.
CRITICAL FACE DIRECTION: turn the actual skull/face/eyes to front THREE-QUARTER SCREEN LEFT, about 40–45 degrees, matching image3. Nose and chin project LEFT; the BROADER NEAR CHEEK and visible ear are toward SCREEN RIGHT, the far eye is narrower toward screen-left but still readable. Pupils look left rather than at viewer. Do not output a frontal face with a decorative tilt. Gentle youthful violet eyes, small warm smile, simple graphic features; no copying the adult sword woman's mature/angry expression. Neck/shoulders connect coherently; chest/waist/knees/shoes agree on the same leftward facing. Grounded standing, both feet visible and planted, natural small weight shift.
Maintain youthful compact project proportions and fully opaque modest clothing; no adult body shaping, bare torso, revealing redesign or sexualized pose.
GEM-ICON DRAWING: substantial broad rounded-angular masses, strong dark-green/ink silhouette, 3 MAIN value planes per major material, saturated controlled greens, clean form-defining light/side turns, sparse wide painterly strokes. Hair and leaf ornaments use large coherent planes, NOT dozens of tiny triangles. Fabric still organic cloth. No generic delicate anime airbrush, glassy jewels, realistic eyes, smooth vector-flat lack of volume, grain, noise, tiny facets or detailed embroidery. Large quiet color areas, few motifs. Full single character including leaf tips/prop/feet on square warm ivory background with safety margin, no extra objects, text, frames or collage. A — MEDICINE CASE. Keep the petal shoulder cape and layered long skirt, but change all dusty-rose petals and motifs to medium leaf-green/sage, all plum belt/shoe/tails to deep forest-green. Ivory stays ivory. Round medicine case becomes dark natural walnut with one small simple pale-green leaf emblem and dull-brass latch. Cut repeated skirt floral prints down to ONE broad leaf motif near a lower hem. Retain both hands cradling the case. Hair crown sprout has two large simple leaves; shorten the side locks to jaw/shoulder length, with a slightly swept fringe opening the face toward LEFT. Make the viewing-direction correction unmistakable: nose left, near cheek/ear right, gaze left, not a frontal tilted doll face. Repaint broad sculptural gem-icon masses without fragmenting the cloth.
